messages:
alex: FYI SupplyWave security questionnaire landed. They want KMS custody proof (cloud + on-prem HSM), RBAC export showing separation of duties, and a 1-paragraph incident response summary for the last 12 months.
maya: Do they want raw logs or redacted samples?
priya: Recommend redacted samples + a README describing redaction. SIEM sample events are usually enough for them to validate fields.
legal: Do not include tenant IDs, account emails, or hostnames. Replace with TENANT-REDACTED / SA-REDACTED / HOST-REDACTED.
sec-bot: [automated] created ticket SEC-3301 (supplywave-sq) Assigned: priya, maya.
alex: For RBAC we can run `redwoodctl export-roles --format csv --anonymize` and include a separate alias map. Columns: principal_alias,role,resource,granted_at.
maya: I'll prep an HSM export example. Internal command: `hsmctl export --chain --since=2026-01-01 --anonymize-uuids` -- remember to strip serials.
priya: SIEM schema to show: timestamp, event_source, actor, tenant_id(masked), resource, action, kms_key_id(masked), operation, request_id, outcome, src_ip(masked).
alex: For key custody proof include envelope metadata only (key ids, thumbprints masked). No private material.
legal: Add a 1-sentence risk statement to the TIMELINE file and a contact blurb for SOC follow-ups.
maya: On CVEs: CVE-2025-1824 patched 2026-02-28; CVE-2025-4009 patched 2026-04-10. Draft timeline will list detection, patch, verification, and communication dates.
priya: Rotation evidence: include an excerpt from `/var/log/rotation-runner/rotate-2026-02.log` showing job run id and status, with any IDs redacted.
alex: Example SIEM event we can include (masked tenant/key): `{"timestamp":"2026-02-28T14:12:03Z","event_source":"kms","actor":"svc-ingest","tenant_id":"TENANT-REDACTED","kms_key_id":"KEY-REDACTED","operation":"Encrypt","request_id":"req-7f4a","outcome":"SUCCESS"}`
maya: Also provide a sample of tenant-provisioning audit lines showing role grants for `onboard_user` flow (principals aliased).
priya: Bundle layout I'll produce: `bundle_supplywave_5051236789/` -> `README.txt` (redaction + file index), `siem_sample.json`, `rbac_export_2026-02-20.csv`, `hsm_export_masked.txt`, `rotation_excerpt.log`, `TIMELINE.txt`.
alex: Can we get this packaged by EOD PST? Ill review before sending to the customer's security contact.
priya: On it. Will upload and post link here.
sec-bot: [automated] bundle_supplywave_5051236789.zip uploaded by priya at 2026-03-21T08:41:15Z.
